_about: Hand-labelled failures for error analysis, grouped by run. 'label' = WHAT went wrong (symptom). 'suspected_cause' = WHY (hypothesis until verified).

_label_set.company_mismatch: Retrieved chunks are from a different company's filing
_label_set.year_mismatch: Right company, wrong fiscal year / period
_label_set.right_doc_wrong_page: Right filing retrieved, but not the gold page

_hypotheses.H1_chunk_lacks_context: Chunks after the top of a page don't contain the company name, year or units, so the embedding can't link them to the right company. Status: SUPPORTED for company matching. With the header (retriever_4_header) there are 0 pure company mismatches among the misses (was 4). Recall@3 stayed at 60%, because new year and page failures appeared.
_hypotheses.H2_embedding_model_weak: all-MiniLM-L6-v2 is small and general-purpose: it matches topic well but is weak at telling entities apart, and reads only the first 256 tokens. Status: suspected, not yet tested. Year mismatches persist even with the year in the header (e.g. 07507 gets ADOBE_2017 instead of ADOBE_2016), which fits this hypothesis.

20261122_005215_retriever_5_page_header_.changes_vs_H1: Fixed: 07507 (year mismatch -> ADOBE_2016 at rank 1). Broke: 02987 (multi-page; all 3 slots from one filing, wrong pages). Partial: 07966 up, 00540 down. MRR dropped on 04672 and 01865. Year mismatches 3 -> 1; right_doc_wrong_page 3 -> 5.
